title: Backyard Smoked Ribs & Sides for a Crowd (Serves 15-20)
description:
Complete crowd BBQ on a gas grill with smoker box. No charcoal needed.

Ingredient list (serves 15-20): St. Louis spare ribs 18 lb (3 full racks ~6 lb each), hickory wood chips 4 cups, apple cider vinegar 1 cup, yellow mustard 2 tbsp. Scratch dry rub: brown sugar 2 cups, kosher salt 4 tbsp, black pepper 3 tbsp, garlic powder 2 tbsp, onion powder 2 tbsp, smoked paprika 2 tbsp, cayenne 1 tsp. Finishing: BBQ sauce 2 bottles 18 oz. Sides: coleslaw mix 2 bags, cornbread mix 3 boxes, baked beans 2 cans 28 oz, mac and cheese 3 boxes, butter 2 sticks, heavy cream 1 pint, sharp cheddar 1 lb. NOTE: gas grill with smoker box method -- charcoal not required.

Covers setup, dry rub application, modified smoking schedule, wrapping, sides prep, and plating for a crowd.

Equipment: Gas grill (any 3-burner), smoker box, heavy duty foil, instant-read thermometer.
The Grillfather BBQ | @GrilfatherBBQ
